resolved_intents.intent: Verify edit feedback screen is visible
Get tell your experience text value

missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should verify that the text entered in the 'tell your experience' field is truncated to the maximum allowed characters. It should: 1) Get the current text value from the feedback text field using get_entered_text(), 2) Get the character count using get_feedback_text_char_count(), 3) Parse the character count to extract current and maximum values, 4) Assert that the current character count equals the maximum allowed characters, 5) Assert that the length of the entered text does not exceed the maximum characters, 6) Return True if truncation is correctly enforced, False otherwise.
